mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_session (token, `user`, `name`, role_key, ip, ua, login_at, expire_at, last_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{user}, #{name}, #{roleKey}, #{ip}, #{ua}, NOW(), #{expireAt}, NOW())
